data.title: Bitcoin surges over 25% as shorts get squeezed and Washington leans into crypto
data.description: Bitcoin has stormed back from a months-long downtrend, tearing through $79,500 on Friday as a wave of short covering collided with a US Treasury liquidity push and a fresh White House embrace of the crypto industry.View on euronews
data.keywords: Commodity Futures Trading Commission, digital assets, President Donald Trump
